dossier.scp_unleashed.006.title: Fountain of Youth
dossier.scp_unleashed.006.caption: The SCP-006 vessel at intake, stopper in place. The stone stayed cold in a warm room.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The SCP-006 vessel is kept stoppered on a padded shelf in a dry, locked storage room. It is opened only for approved tests, and never over open ground.

Any standing body of SCP-006 is to be fenced off and signposted. No creature taken from another file is to be brought within reach of it. %rRequests to bathe in SCP-006 are logged and reviewed by the Site Director.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-006 is a quantity of clear water with a faint silver sheen. Its source has never been found. The Foundation holds what was brought to it in a weathered stone vessel with a carved stopper, which holds rather more than its size suggests.
In every test SCP-006 behaves exactly like ordinary water. It flows and pools, puts out fires, and can be carried in a bucket.

Any living thing that touches SCP-006 is restored at once. Hurts close, sickness passes, and lingering troubles of an anomalous kind lift with them. The effect does not depend on the subject's nature or intent, and it has never been seen to fail.
The vessel itself has never refilled. Researchers expect it to break once it is empty.

page.title: Addendum 006-1: Test Log
text: Test 006-02: D-4410, hurt in an earlier test and feeling unwell, dipped one hand into a basin of SCP-006. He was well again before he had drawn it out.
Test 006-04: a wounded hostile specimen was lowered into a trough of SCP-006. It recovered fully, and the test was ended early. %rDo not repeat this test.%r
Test 006-07: a subject suffering a lingering affliction described in another file waded into a pool of SCP-006. The affliction lifted and did not return.

page.title: Addendum 006-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-006 has no recovery record. The vessel was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp006_vessel.tooltip: An old stone jug with a carved stopper. It is cold to the touch, and something inside catches the light.
item.scp_unleashed.scp006_vessel.detail: Use it on a surface to pour out a bucket's worth
item.scp_unleashed.scp006_vessel.pipes: Tanks and pipes can draw from it as well
item.scp_unleashed.scp006_vessel.fragile: Nothing refills it, and it will not survive its last pour
item.scp_unleashed.scp006_bucket.tooltip: Clear water with a faint silver sheen. It feels lighter than it should.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp006_vessel.1: An old stone vessel holding SCP-006, a clear water with a faint silver sheen. Use it on a surface to pour out a bucket's worth, just as a bucket would.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp006_vessel.2: It holds %s pours and cannot be refilled. Tanks and pipes can draw from it too. Whatever takes the last of it, the vessel does not survive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp006_vessel.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-006 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a stranger in Foundation dress delivers the vessel in person.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp006_bucket.1: A bucket of SCP-006. It pours, flows and pools like ordinary water, and an empty bucket scoops it back up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp006_bucket.2: Whatever lives and touches it is mended: hurts, sickness and stranger troubles alike. It does not choose whom it helps.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp006.0: A courier brings the stone vessel by hand.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp006.1: It mends anything that touches it. Anything.
